title: Llama holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q60 50 55 62' stroke='#ffe082' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='24' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='20' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <path d='M66 37 L63 40 L69 40 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='62' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='29' y='72' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <rect x='38' y='72' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <rect x='47' y='72' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <rect x='54' y='72' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='29' y='83' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>
  <rect x='38' y='83' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>
  <rect x='47' y='83' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>
  <rect x='54' y='83' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a96e'/>

  <rect x='50' y='38' width='10' height='22' rx='5' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='32' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='22' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e8d4a8' transform='rotate(-15 48 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e8d4a8' transform='rotate(15 64 22)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='36' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ecd6b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M58 38 Q60 40 63 38' stroke='#3a2a1a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon string -->
  <path d='M56 55 Q60 54 62 50' stroke='#e8d4a8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- fluffy tail -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ecd6b0'/>
</svg>
